reuse.why: Adds one guard function and keeps all linking through the existing linkBankSyncAccount, but the guard is called from each of the five provider handlers rather than from that shared link sequence.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link query is written once; the only repetition is five near-identical guard calls placed before each provider's bank lookup.

placement.why: Lives in server/accounts/app.ts beside linkBankSyncAccount; running it before findOrCreateBank explains why it sits in the callers, though a single entry point (for example passing the bank lookup into the shared helper) would keep it in one layer.

scope.why: Only the duplicate-link guard and its tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, named guard with a single query; a sixth provider must remember to call it, since it is not enforced by the shared link helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All handlers still link through linkBankSyncAccount; the guard is an addition at each caller, not a way around the helper.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the five one-line guard calls.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts defines the rule and is called by all five link handlers (GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Enable Banking), though each caller must invoke it itself.
